summary: Polish + reliability pass fully verified on Expo web preview (390x844). Backend: 14/14 pytest pass, including 5 NEW /api/voice fallback tests (204 No Content for line=success/mission_intro/failure/adventure_complete AND unknown line when ELEVENLABS_API_KEY is empty). Frontend E2E happy path completed: onboarding -> Home (Ionicons flame/star/compass vector icons visible, no emoji) -> START ADVENTURE -> 3 missions -> Adventure Complete -> GO AGAIN -> new Mission Reveal. Play Scavvy audio button state transitions verified: after arriving on Success it AUTO-enters 'SCAVVY IS SPEAKING...' (~t=2.4s once staged reveal finishes) then restores to 'PLAY SCAVVY'; manual press flips it back to 'SCAVVY IS SPEAKING...'; rapid double-press (2 clicks with 80ms gap) did NOT crash and state cleanly restored to 'PLAY SCAVVY' after ~1.5s. 0 audio-related console errors in the audio run; backend /api/voice returned 204 confirming bundled-clip fallback path. Success screen shows 'MISSION COMPLETE', +XP counter, top-left success-home-button (chevron+Home) which correctly returns to Home. success-bubble (Pressable containing scavvy_line) tappable without crash. Adventure Complete shows complete-headline 'ADVENTURE COMPLETE', 3/3 missions, 320 XP, +1 streak, personality summary line, and 4 trait bars (Explorer/Observation/Curiosity/Chaos). complete-home-button returns to Home. GO AGAIN starts a brand-new adventure (mission-title visible on Reveal, home streak/missions counter incremented to 28). Glassmorphism floating tab bar renders translucent with 3 tabs (tab-home, tab-adventures, tab-profile); switching between them works; active tab uses orange color; content is NOT clipped behind the floating bar. Mission Reveal shows chevron+'Back' (reveal-back) that returns to Home. Mascot images render on all screens (splash, welcome, home, reveal, camera, analyzing, success, complete). Single non-blocking React warning ('Cannot update a component while rendering a different component' during navigation into Mission Reveal) observed once — not audio-related, does not affect UX. Deprecated packages detected: none. Deprecated style/prop warnings from iteration_1 (shadow.*, pointerEvents, useNativeDriver on web) still non-blocking.

react_native_issues.issue: React warning 'Cannot update a component (`ForwardRef(NavigationContainerInner)`) while rendering a different component (`Mission...`)' fires once when navigating into Mission Reveal via router.replace. Non-blocking; UX unaffected. Likely a setState called during render in reveal.tsx or a screen useEffect that navigates. Reference: /app/frontend/app/mission/reveal.tsx

'shadow*' style props are deprecated on RN Web (use boxShadow). Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme.ts (shadow.soft/card/button) used across ui.tsx, success.tsx, analyzing.tsx, camera.tsx, GlassTabBar.tsx

'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Reference: /app/frontend/app/mission/camera.tsx:128 and /app/frontend/src/components/GlassTabBar.tsx:22 (both use <View pointerEvents="...">)

'useNativeDriver is not supported because the native animated module is missing.' Expected on web preview; consider Platform.OS gate. Reference: multiple screens using Animated.spring/timing with useNativeDriver: true

action_items: (Optional polish) Investigate the one-time NavigationContainer setState-in-render warning during Mission Reveal entry; likely a state update inside a component body or useLayoutEffect that should move to useEffect. Non-blocking.
(Optional polish, carried from iteration_1) Migrate theme shadow.* to boxShadow to silence RN Web deprecation.
(Optional polish, carried from iteration_1) Move pointerEvents to style.pointerEvents in camera.tsx and GlassTabBar.tsx.
(Optional polish, carried from iteration_1) Gate useNativeDriver by Platform.OS !== 'web' to silence web warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py logger is still declared AFTER the routes (logging.basicConfig / logger = getLogger at file bottom). Any early exception path that calls logger.warning would throw NameError. Move logger init above route handlers.
server.py adventure_summary/build_missions use timezone-aware datetimes and hashlib-seeded RNG — clean.
voice.ts has a well-crafted fallback: 5s AbortController on fetch, non-200 => bundled clip, safety-net setTimeout(done, 6000) so button state always restores. Good UX defensive coding.
success.tsx correctly stops voice on unmount, on Home nav, and before Next to avoid overlap. Rapid press is guarded by early-return in playScavvy when speaking=true (verified end-to-end).
